evals.prompt: Build the site header for a 5-page marketing site — logo, links (Work, Services, About, Contact) and a "Book a call" CTA. It should stick to the top, and once you scroll it turns into a floating pill with a blur background.
evals.expected_output: app/components/layout/NavBar.vue implementing the classic layout with the float scroll behavior, a mobile drawer, a desktop CTA, and active-link styling via text-primary.
assertions: The float behavior uses inset-x-4 top-3 rounded-2xl once scrolled
The scroll listener is registered with { passive: true } and cleaned up on unmount
The desktop CTA is always rendered, in addition to any mobile CTA

evals.prompt: The design brief calls for the minimal-overlay navigation: no inline links at all, the burger visible on every screen size, the current page name in the bar with an index counter, and the full-screen menu opening with the layered animation. Page names are Home, Studio, Work, Journal, Contact.
evals.expected_output: NavBar.vue (always-burger bar with logo, current page name, counter, GSAP morph) and NavFullOverlay.vue (layered open sequence) with matching heights and a reduced-motion path.
assertions: The burger is visible at all breakpoints (never md:hidden) and no inline links are rendered
The open animation resets elements hidden by the previous close with gsap.set
The bar height matches between NavBar.vue and NavFullOverlay.vue
The prefers-reduced-motion path leaves the overlay fully usable (display flex, items visible)

evals.prompt: We need a transparent header sitting over the hero that gets a solid background after ~40px of scroll. There's also a Resources item that should open a dropdown with Blog, Docs and Changelog.
evals.expected_output: A NavBar with a scrolled-state class driven by a passive scroll listener and a Radix DropdownMenu for the Resources item, closing the menu on route change.
assertions: Imports the dropdown primitives from radix-vue
The background change is driven by a scrolled ref toggled around the 40px threshold
The open menu closes when the route changes
ThemeToggle/LanguageSwitcher are explicitly imported, not relied on via Nuxt auto-import
